backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing paintings and user profiles with admin-controlled CRUD operations and authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Report mapping implemented features to affected files, components, and test IDs for traceability.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining global styles and theme variables for the dark noir aesthetic.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading the main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration with layout, public gallery routes, and admin-protected dashboard route.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPaint: Form component for creating or editing paintings, handling image uploads, validation, and submit mutations.
Displays a table of paintings with edit and delete actions, including loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Shows an access denied message with login and return buttons based on authentication status.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteG: Guards admin routes by checking admin access and showing loading or denial screens when appropriate.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button that manages Internet Identity authentication state and triggers actions.
Email contact CTA component generating mailto links for painting purchase inquiries.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Renders site footer with contact info, mission text, and attribution link.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Top navigation bar showing logo, login button, and admin link when user is an authenticated admin.
frontend/src/components/MissionStatement: Component rendering the mission statement highlighting community housing support.
frontend/src/components/PaintingCard.tsx: Card component displaying a painting’s image, title, description, and price with link to its detail page.
frontend/src/constants/contact.ts: Exports the contact email and helper to build a mailto link with subject and body.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAccess.ts: Determines whether the user is authenticated and an admin by checking Internet Identity and role query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, managing login, logout, stored identities, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for managing paintings and user roles, including CRUD mutations and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom OKLCH CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry that sets up React, React Query, Internet Identity, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin dashboard for listing, creating, and editing paintings with modal dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/GalleryPage.tsx: Public gallery page displaying a hero section, mission statement, and painting grid with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/pages/PaintingDetailPage.ts: Detail view for a single painting with image carousel, description, price, and navigation handling.
frontend/src/utils/format.ts: Utility to format bigint prices into USD currency strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, typography, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Describes the current website project state, including goals, required images, and implemented features for a public painting gallery with email-based purchasing and an admin dashboard. Also tracks architectural notes, versioning, and feature list entries.
